name: Section of the prime chain on a Reinhardt shell around the critical torus, with the gamma one-port
statement: Device proposal of campaign round 7 (lane c7-laurent-shell-gamma-section; not reported when this node was written). In the bridge / spinor square-root setting (S = N/D, Cayley transform of alpha F'/F), take sections of the prime chain as Laurent series on a Reinhardt shell r < abs(z_p) < 1/r around the torus abs(z_p) = p^(-1/2), with the gamma one-port kept in the chain. Rows Q12 and Q22 close passive and J-contractive sections on the polydisc without the gamma term; the shell with the gamma term is their uncovered remainder. Question: is there a limit step on the shell (requirement R4), and does the first-moment sign differ for Davenport-Heilbronn (requirement R3). No statement about zeros.

name: Function-field ORDER-2 vertex: Proposition 2.1 probe with h > 1 in F_q[T]
statement: Device proposal of campaign round 7 (lane c7-ff-order2-vertex-exact, pre-registered compute; not reported when this node was written). In F_q[T], where the Riemann hypothesis is a theorem, test in exact arithmetic whether a probe of the Proposition 2.1 format realises signal constant h > 1 in the region lx < l. Outcome h > 1: effective order 2 stays a lead and the next step names the sheaf-theoretic input. Outcome h <= 1: the format is capped independently of the truth of the hypothesis. Constraint from map row Z24: the normaliser of the probe must have no zeros in Re s > 1/2 (for sextic rows it contains L(6s-3, psi) and the format stops at 2/3). No statement about zeros of zeta.
